title: Risk recapture rate
one_line_definition: The proportion of recaptured risk out of the total eligible recapture opportunity, expressed as a percentage.
numerator_meaning: The sum of recapture_numerator values, representing the HCC risk weight that has been successfully recaptured (i.e., previously undocumented or gap conditions that have now been coded).
denominator_meaning: The sum of recapture_denominator values, representing the total HCC risk weight eligible for recapture across all applicable conditions.
result_meaning: Shows what percentage of the total recapture opportunity has been successfully acted upon, indicating how effectively the organisation is closing coding gaps.

measure_meanings.Risk recapture rate: The percentage of eligible HCC risk weight that has been recaptured, calculated as recaptured risk divided by total recapturable risk.
measure_meanings.Risk recapture rate YoY Card: Displays the year-over-year percentage change in the risk recapture rate compared to the same period last year, shown as an upward or downward arrow with the percentage difference.
